fact: On 3 April 2025 Djamo, an Ivorian fintech, secured a USD 17 million equity round led by Janngo Capital with Partech, Oikocredit, Enza Capital and others.
title: DJAMO HITS 1M ACTIVE CUSTOMERS AND RAISES $17M OF EQUITY TO DOUBLE DOWN ON DIGITAL-FIRST BANKING SERVICES FOR USERS ACROSS FRANCOPHONE AFRICA
